symptom: A third combined GitHub write was rejected by connector safety controls after two earlier occurrences of the same failure class.
root_cause: The execution pattern still allowed combined writes after bounded writes had already been identified as the stable workaround.
early_signals: ERR-20260926-019 already classified recurrence as regression
human_cost: No operator intervention; execution policy tightened to one bounded write per call.
prevention_rule: After repeated connector policy blocks, enforce one bounded write per tool call for the remainder of the objective.
automated_detection: Repeated occurrence references prior controlled errors and is classified as repeated regression.
